wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |mode=Basketball |year=2022–23 |team=North Alabama Lions |image=North Alabama Lions wordmark.svg |image_size= 250 |conference=ASUN Conference |division= |short_conf=ASUN |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=18–15 |conf_record=10–8 |head_coach=[[Tony Pujol]] |hc_year=5th |asst_coach1=Ahmad Smith |asst_coach2=Willie Watson |asst_coach3=Carter Heston |stadium=[[Flowers Hall]] |champion= |bowl=[[2023 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] |bowl_result=first round }} {{2022–23 ASUN men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 North Alabama Lions men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of North Alabama]] in the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Lions, led by fifth-year head coach [[Tony Pujol]], played their home games at [[Flowers Hall]] in [[Florence, Alabama]] as members of the West division of the [[ASUN Conference]]. They finished the season 18–15, 10–8 in ASUN play, to finish in sixth place.{{Cite web |title=2022-23 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://asunsports.org/standings.aspx?standings=43 |access-date=2025-07-24 |website=asunsports.org}} They lost to [[2022–23 Eastern Kentucky Colonels men's basketball team|Eastern Kentucky]] in the first round of the [[2023 ASUN men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]].{{Cite web |date=2023-02-28 |title=LIONS FALL IN QUARTERFINALS OF ASUN TOURNAMENT |url=https://roarlions.com/news/2023/2/28/mens-basketball-lions-fall-in-quarterfinals-of-asun-tournament.aspx |access-date=2025-07-24 |website=University of North Alabama Athletics |language=en}} The Lions received an invitation to play in the [[2023 College Basketball Invitational]] (CBI), where they were defeated in the first round by [[2022–23 Southern Utah Thunderbirds men's basketball team|Southern Utah]].{{Cite web |date=2023-03-18 |title=LIONS FALL IN FIRST ROUND OF CBI |url=https://roarlions.com/news/2023/3/18/mens-basketball-lions-fall-in-first-round-of-cbi.aspx
